newsitem.title: UK: BOC ADRs start to trade in New York.
newsitem.headline: BOC ADRs start to trade in New York.

text.p: UK-based industrial gases to healthcare group BOC Group Plc said on Wednesday its American Depositary Receipts have started trade on the New York Stock Exchange.
Each ADR, under the stock symbol BOX.N, represents two BOC ordinary shares. JP Morgan is the acting depositary bank, the company added in a statement.

"Our sponsored ADR programme and listing reflects a growing interest in the BOC Group by U.S. investors who appreciate the growth potential of our business," said Danny Rosenkranz, BOC's chief executive.
About 20 percent of the group's employees are based in the U.S. and the operation clocked up sales of more than one billion pounds last year. BOC said the U.S. was its most important market.
